Dixon Residential are delighted to present No.21 The Crescent Building to the market.

This spacious dual aspect two-bedroom apartment offers bright, well-proportioned accommodation extending to approximately 81 sq.m / 868 sq.ft, ideally positioned within this sought-after development. 

The accommodation briefly comprises an inviting entrance hall, a large living and dining area which opens onto the kitchen, two spacious double bedrooms including a primary bedroom with en-suite bathroom, and a main family bathroom. Large windows throughout allow for an abundance of natural light, enhancing the sense of space throughout the apartment.

 Residents can also enjoy the well-maintained communal gardens, perfect for relaxing or entertaining guests. Additional highlights include lift access and the property's prime location, just a 2-minute walk from a variety of local amenities and services. Parkwest Business Park, the Red Cow Luas, the M50 motorway, and Clondalkin village are all within easy reach, making this an ideal location for both work and leisure. The Parkwest and Cherry Orchard train stations are also nearby, providing excellent transport links to the wider Dublin area.

No. 21 The Crescent Building combines comfort and convenience in a superb residential setting, making it an excellent choice for first-time buyers, downsizers, or investors alike.
